answer: A state pharmacy license proves a real dispenser. It is issued only after a board inspection and a pharmacist-in-charge background check, and its number is verified against the public board registry, one license per inspected address, with a fresh inspection each renewal. An honest pharmacy pays $500 a year plus one inspection morning; 1,000 fake identities need $500,000 in forged licenses plus 1,000 fake inspections, while canyon auditors, umber inspectors and pearl clerks each verify a different part for free.
